generation.mode: built-in ImageGen edit with edit-target as Image 1 and canon as reference-only Image 2

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; water-mask pixels and adjacent pixels excluded, and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No cast-shadow field or explicit sun is visible, but basalt caps are repeatedly paler than cliff faces and conifers retain directional form modelling. The literal same-value-on-every-side constraint is not met.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: Manual screen-space estimate over non-water land at native source resolution.
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad coherent bench and shelf tops count as buildable; exposed column faces count as steep; talus, shingle, detached rock, scrub, and conifer footprints make up the remainder.
buildableVsSteepFraction.limitation: Visual estimate rather than elevation-derived slope or world-space surface area.

crown.method: Complete visual census of all eight distinguishable conifer crowns, including the edge-clipped arrival; measured crown-width bounding boxes at native 1254 px, median 35.5 px, then scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 4.8 cm per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.derivation: The edge-connected cyan and blue source surface was expanded through adjacent wet neutral, pale surf, wash, ripple, and reflection pixels; enclosed classifier gaps of at most 64 pixels were filled. The traced mask follows the full connected source-visible sea and fall rather than stopping at an open-water polygon.
waterMask.interiorTransparentTerrainNote: Transparent islands enclosed by sea are visibly dry stacks, columns, talus, or shore rocks, not omitted water texture.

refusalReasons: The edit added seven full conifers in the newly painted shore regions even though the shore biome permits no trees of its own; the eighth census crown is an edge-clipped arrival.
Repeated pale column caps over darker vertical faces and modelled conifer shading violate the literal neutral-lighting requirement despite the absence of a cast-shadow field or explicit sun.
Several long cliff sections read as repeated upright columns with clean pale caps rather than consistently weathered, split, leaning, irregular ordinary coast.
openRisks: The source cannot be corrected without violating the one-edit-call limit; its square result does not authorize a framing retry.
The edit target and prose edge map are not visually identical at the north and south boundaries; the required edit-target authority was followed and its painted pixels were supplied to ImageGen.
Buildable and steep fractions and the crown census are image measurements, not surveyed geometry.
Exact seam continuity, exact water-mask edge judgment, landform naturalism, and visual quality remain director and owner judgments; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
